sentences.text: 2. As per the e-courts service website, the evidence is already started in these cases and PW-1 is already examined.
In such circumstances I am of the considered opinion that these cases need not be retained here.
All the contentions raised by the petitioners are left open and the petitioners are free to agitate the same before the trial court at the appropriate stage.
With the above observation, this criminal miscellaneous case is disposed of.
